newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar weak, funds, trade sell.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar weak, funds, trade sell.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were weaker but off the three-week lows hit early amid heavy trade and fund selling, dealers said.
At 1130 EDT, most-active July was down 0.17 cent to 10.79 cents per lb, having ranged from 10.86 to 10.72 cents, the low hit on April 7. The rest of the board stood 0.17 to 0.08 cent lower.
Volume was estimated at a brisk 21,398 lots by 1100 EDT.
"The Brazilians sold on the rally in May and now they are selling July," Merrill Lynch sugar broker, Peter Perez, said.
Trade selling triggered stops around support at 10.91 cents and prompted liquidation by the funds, sending prices to the lows, dealers said.
The trade emerged as a scale-down buyer around 10.75 cents basis July and carried prices towards the middle of the range.
Another broker said the market is oversold on a short-term basis and is likely to rest around current levels.

Wednesday, the May contract expired on a weak note amid expectations for heavy deliveries, which were now keeping front-month July under pressure. The bearish close prompted selling in London, which further contributed to negative sentiment in New York, a broker said.
There were 6,801 delivery notices issued today, CSCE said.
((-- S Rostler, New York Commodities Desk, 212 859 1640))
